notFound.title: This match was not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another club.

review.title: Against {{opponent}}
review.subtitle: {{date}} · {{status}}

empty.title: No events were recorded in this match
empty.body: Tag chances, box entries and recoveries during the match, and the review fills in here.

top.title: Who was on top
top.intro: The balance of chances through the match, and how far you can trust it. Drag across the chart to read any moment.

shots.title: Where the chances came from
shots.mapLabel: Shot map of the attacking half, goal at the top. Shots by {{home}}: {{homeShots}}, drawn as circles. Shots by {{away}}: {{awayShots}}, drawn as diamonds. Bigger marks are better chances; goals are ringed. Totals follow below.
shots.notDrawn: Not drawn: {{unplaced}} without a tapped location, {{ownHalf}} from the own half.
shots.estimateNote: Chance quality is a pro-calibrated estimate: our model was trained on men's professional shots, so for a youth team it ranks chances rather than giving a probability of scoring.

focus.title: What to work on
focus.disclaimer: A prompt from the counts, not a diagnosis. Check it against what you saw.
focus.limitTitle: What the counts cannot tell you
focus.insufficient: Not enough tags for a suggestion yet: {{events}} recorded, at least {{minimum}} needed.
focus.none: Nothing in the counts stands out for this match.

build_up.name: Build-up play
build_up.limit: Whether the losses came from risky passes, a poor first touch or simply a strong press.

finishing.name: Finishing
finishing.limit: Whether the entries were real chances, or wide and crowded positions where a shot was not on.

receiving_under_pressure.name: Receiving under pressure
receiving_under_pressure.limit: Which players were caught on the ball, or whether the passes into them were too slow.

pressing.name: Pressing
pressing.limit: Whether the team chose to defend deep on purpose, or recoveries simply went untagged.

one_v_one_defending.name: One-v-one defending
one_v_one_defending.limit: Whether the chances came from duels lost, from set pieces, or from mistakes elsewhere.

reason.lostOwnHalf: Ball lost in our own half: {{lost}}
reason.opponentHighRecoveries: Opponent won the ball high up the pitch: {{recoveries}}

connecting.label: Connecting.
connecting.body: This match is still open; the page will follow it as events are recorded.

live.label: Live.
live.body: This page updates by itself as events are recorded, on any phone.

offline.label: Live updates paused.
offline.body: Showing the last events received. They resume when the connection is back.

origins.title: How the chances came about
origins.intro: What was tagged in the 30 seconds before each shot, for you and for the opponent. A pattern shows only where the lead-up was tagged.
origins.caption: {{team}} · chances: {{chances}}

origin.pressing: After winning the ball high up the pitch
origin.turnover: After the other side lost the ball in its own half

detail.stable: Every window agrees, and no single chance would change it.
detail.event-sensitive: It rests on one chance. Take it as a hint, not a verdict.
detail.window-sensitive: It depends on how far back you look.
detail.level: Chances for both, and no window favours either team.
detail.insufficient: No chances were recorded in the ten minutes before it.
